017package org.apache.juneau.server.config.rest;
018
019import java.nio.charset.*;
020import java.security.*;
021
022import org.apache.juneau.config.*;
023import org.apache.juneau.http.response.*;
024import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.*;
025import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.guard.*;
026
027/**
028 * Guard that protects {@link LoadConfigResource} with a shared API key.
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * The expected key is read from the <c>[Security]</c> section of <c>juneau-server-config.cfg</c>:
032 * <p class='bini'>
033 *    <cs>[Security]</cs>
034 *    <ck>apiKey</ck> = <cv>some-long-random-secret</cv>
035 * </p>
036 *
037 * <p>
038 * Clients supply the key in either an <c>Authorization: Bearer &lt;key&gt;</c> header or an <c>X-Api-Key</c> header.
039 * The comparison is constant-time ({@link MessageDigest#isEqual(byte[], byte[])} over UTF-8 bytes).
040 *
041 * <p>
042 * The guard <b>fails closed</b>: if no key is configured (missing, empty or unreadable setting), every request is
043 * rejected with a 403.  The key is never logged or echoed.  Always use TLS.
044 */
045public class ConfigApiKeyGuard extends RestGuard {
046
047   private static final String CONFIG_NAME = "juneau-server-config.cfg";
048   private static final String CONFIG_KEY = "Security/apiKey";
049   private static final String BEARER = "Bearer ";
050
051   @Override /* Overridden from RestGuard */
052   public boolean guard(RestRequest req, RestResponse res) throws BasicHttpException {
053      if (! isAuthorized(configuredKey(), req.getHeader("Authorization"), req.getHeader("X-Api-Key")))
054         throw new Forbidden("Access denied.");
055      return true;
056   }
057
058   @Override /* Overridden from RestGuard */
059   public boolean isRequestAllowed(RestRequest req) {
060      return isAuthorized(configuredKey(), req.getHeader("Authorization"), req.getHeader("X-Api-Key"));
061   }
062
063   /**
064    * Returns the configured key, or <jk>null</jk> if none is configured or the configuration cannot be read.
065    *
066    * @return The configured key, or <jk>null</jk>.
067    */
068   protected String configuredKey() {
069      try {
070         return Config.create().name(CONFIG_NAME).build().get(CONFIG_KEY).orElse(null);
071      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") Exception e) {
072         // Fail closed; deliberately do not log (avoid leaking config content).
073         return null;
074      }
075   }
076
077   static boolean isAuthorized(String configured, String authorization, String xApiKey) {
078      if (configured == null || configured.isEmpty())
079         return false;
080      var expected = configured.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
081      var ok = false;
082      if (authorization != null && authorization.regionMatches(true, 0, BEARER, 0, BEARER.length()))
083         ok = matches(expected, authorization.substring(BEARER.length()).trim());
084      if (xApiKey != null)
085         ok |= matches(expected, xApiKey.trim());
086      return ok;
087   }
088
089   private static boolean matches(byte[] expected, String supplied) {
090      return MessageDigest.isEqual(expected, supplied.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
091   }
092}
